name: zen-notes-widget
description: A block-based notes widget for the Zen Browser sidebar with nested lists and atomic local storage
author: jjspscl
features: Lean pinned sidebar widget above workspace indicators
Bold, italic, underline, and strikethrough formatting
Nested bullet, numbered, and to-do blocks with markdown shortcuts
Links with an http/https/mailto scheme allowlist
Legacy HTML migration into the schema v5 block data model
Atomic profile-file storage with backups and 2.4.x compatibility mirror
